clips.title: The story
paras: West of the Crossroads, Regthar Deathgate calls for Centaur Bracers. Kolkar centaurs contest the central Barrens, threatening Horde control of the plains.

The young Horde is fighting to secure territory across Kalimdor. The Barrens lie between Durotar and Mulgore, but Kolkar centaurs contest its watering holes and open plains. They attack supply trains and scouting parties. Regthar Deathgate, an orc warrior, directs the defense from his bunker west of the Crossroads.

Regthar asks for proof that Kolkar warriors have fallen. Soldiers who enter Kolkar territory bring back bracers taken from slain centaurs. The trophies verify claims for Horde bounties and are meant to frighten surviving Kolkar raiders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Kolkar are a threat to the Horde's claims in the Barrens; we must reduce the numbers of their troops. And so, I have a bounty task for you.
While in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers. Return when you have a heap of bracers and the Horde will reward you well.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Nicely done. I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, friend. If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.
But I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.
